commits.subject: composite + harness (SMB-COMPOSITE-NETWORK-ADAPTER): Folio adapter reads vector networks

capabilities_done: (1) composite Folio adapter: VectorAssets::network(path_id) -> Option<StudioVectorNetwork> (defaulted None, non-breaking for every existing implementor); prepare_vectors -> FolioCx::networks: a vector layer path with a network record draws nib fill_geometry (filled regions, region winding rule) as its geometry and every Stroke row becomes FillPaint::StrokeGeometry over the nib stroke outline (vector_nib::stroke_outline) of its stroke_geometry; plain paths of the same layer fill and stroke themselves; layers without networks unchanged

(1) vector::nib_network: Folio record -> nib VectorNetwork (cap projecting = square), sizes checked against nib MAX_NETWORK_ELEMENTS / MAX_REGIONS / MAX_LOOP_REFERENCES before conversion, then nib validate; typed refusals vector_network (indices, budgets, open loops, non-finite) and vector_network_region_style (a region with its own fill_style_id: one fill style per layer)

(1) harness: Viewer::render_folio_vectors(design, records) renders the open document through composite::prepare_vectors (paths and network records from the saved vector entry, EntryAssets), render-cpu, linear-light plan; a refused layer is an error. view::vector::network_of now delegates to composite's converter (one Folio->nib mapping)

(1) proof: harness tests/viewer_network_adapter.rs draws a rect, promotes it to a network, pen-joins a divider, paint-buckets one face, saves, reopens in a fresh viewer and renders through the Folio adapter with test-built Folio design records (red fill row, blue 2 px stroke row): red only in the filled face, blue on every edge and the divider, white in the unfilled face, and the frame equals the viewer's pre-save frame byte for byte

(2) composite DESCRIPTOR vector entry: StrokeGeometry rows (lane SMB-COMPOSITE-STROKE-GEOMETRY) and vector networks (VectorAssets::network, nib_network, refusals, proofs); only this hunk of lib.rs committed

tests.argv: cargo nextest run -p hsk-studio-composite --test vector_network --test vector_nib --test vector_lowering (5/5); cargo nextest run -p hsk-studio-harness --features viewer --test viewer_network_adapter --test viewer_vector_3 --test viewer_vector_4 (7/7); cargo nextest run -p hsk-studio-composite --test static_plan (5/5, DESCRIPTOR parses)
tests.sha: 5fef9fb (worktree tested before commit; staged content = tested files)

next: Validator: judge the lane. Suggested next: harness authoring of Folio design records (fill/stroke paint styles) so the viewer's own render path can use the Folio adapter; a Folio width-profile record for variable-width strokes (today harness-entry only).

notes.approval: Lead 2026-10-15: same rules as SMB-COMPOSITE-STROKE-GEOMETRY (own composite vector stroke lowering); DESCRIPTOR own hunk of lib.rs only
notes.shared_files: composite lib.rs: only the DESCRIPTOR hunk staged via HEAD blob + replacement (stage_blob.py); other lanes' lib.rs re-export hunks, composite composition/temporal/vector_mask WIP, harness mod.rs and tests/common were not staged; composite src/vector.rs and harness src/view/vector.rs diffs held only this lane's hunks (checked)

spec_basis.STU-VEC-108: MUST expose the derived read-only fill_geometry and stroke_geometry path sets (the adapter paints both from the stored record)
spec_basis.STU-VEC-001: vector paths and networks are Folio records

gaps: the harness authors no Folio design records (StudioDesignRecords): the proof builds them in the test; the viewer's interactive render still uses its own specs
per-region fill styles (StudioNetworkRegion.fill_style_id) are refused, not painted
variable-width strokes have no Folio record; only the harness entry stores width profiles, so the adapter cannot render them
per-vertex stroke cap/join overrides are stored, not rendered
notes.retry_guard: not triggered (all runs green first time)
notes.v4: V4-01 deny(arithmetic_side_effects) in vector.rs (checked_add / try_fold for budgets); V4-02 network sizes refused before conversion; V4-09 commit -F
